hero.title_html: Turn any idea into a complete piece of software.
hero.description: Describe your project in plain language. Trem Forge automatically builds websites, apps, systems, APIs, and databases — and publishes everything to the cloud in minutes.

agents.title: Six agents. One journey.
agents.subtitle: Instead of a single generic model, an orchestrator splits your idea among specialists that work in parallel.
agents.architect_desc: Analyzes your requirements and defines the right architecture and technologies for the project.
agents.designer_desc: Designs intuitive interfaces, color palette, and typography with accessibility built in.
agents.developer_desc: Implements the code following best practices, with automated tests and performance in mind.
agents.database_desc: Models the database, optimizes queries, and ensures referential integrity.
agents.qa_desc: Creates test cases, runs validations, and catches bugs before you ever see them.
agents.deploy_desc: Sets up production, automates publishing, and monitors the live result.

chat_demo.title: Chat with the TremForge AI
chat_demo.subtitle: Describe your idea and watch the orchestrator sketch a plan in real time.
chat_demo.greeting: Hi! Tell me your idea — an app, a website, a system — and I'll help you sketch the project plan.
chat_demo.footnote: Demo — responses are AI-generated and may vary.

cta_final.title: Ready to put your idea on the rails?
cta_final.subtitle: No setup, no friction. Just hop on and watch the software leave the station.
